selected.ai_summary_en: Daiichi Sankyo announced first dosing in TROPION-Urothelial04 on August 27. The global phase 3 trial evaluates the anti-TROP2 ADC Dato-DXd alone or with the PD-1/TIGIT bispecific rilvegostomig as adjuvant treatment for high-risk muscle-invasive urothelial cancer after neoadjuvant therapy and surgery. Around 915 participants are planned, with disease-free survival as the primary endpoint. This is trial initiation, not a positive comparative efficacy result.
